def factor_volume_price_corr_efficiency_clipped(df):
    """Rolling price-volume correlation with clipped volume change and path-efficiency weight."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    ret = close.pct_change()
    vol_change = volume.pct_change().clip(-0.8, 0.8)
    corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(vol_change)
    net_move = (close - close.shift(20)).abs()
    path_length = close.diff().abs().rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    efficiency = (net_move / path_length.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 1.0).fillna(0.5)
    factor = corr * efficiency
    df_copy["factor_volume_price_corr_efficiency_clipped"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_price_corr_efficiency_clipped"]
